name: bandwagon
description: App for the taiwan baseball bandwagon fan

scripts.docker:run-local:piggyback: docker run --env NODE_ENV=dev -e DEPLOY_ENV=local -e RUNTIME_ENVIRONMENT=node -v ./.cert:/.cert bandwagon/piggyback
scripts.docker:run-local:dugout: docker run -p 8080:8080 --env NODE_ENV=dev -e DEPLOY_ENV=local -e RUNTIME_ENVIRONMENT=node -v ./.cert:/.cert bandwagon/dugout
